final: WITH account_counts AS (SELECT a.district_id, d.A3 as region, COUNT(*) as account_count FROM account a JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id GROUP BY a.district_id, d.A3), region_averages AS (SELECT region, AVG(account_count) as region_avg FROM account_counts GROUP BY region), above_average AS (SELECT ac.district_id, ac.region, ac.account_count, ac.account_count - ra.region_avg as exceeds FROM account_counts ac JOIN region_averages ra ON ac.region = ra.region WHERE ac.account_count > ra.region_avg), filtered_avg AS (SELECT AVG(account_count) as avg_count FROM above_average) SELECT aa.district_id, aa.region, aa.account_count, aa.exceeds, aa.account_count / fa.avg_count as ratio FROM above_average aa CROSS JOIN filtered_avg fa ORDER BY ratio DESC LIMIT 10
